name: GridCraft

limitations: - OpenGL: tested on AROS One 1.3, which has only Mesa's software renderer,
so AUTO uses CPU there. GPU has not been tested in this release.
- Tested from a Shell with scripted edits; typing, the file requester and
the clipboard were tested on mainline AROS only.

aros-x86_64-abiv1-pc.system: AROS x86_64, mainline ABIv1 (nightly 2026-11-06 or later)
aros-x86_64-abiv1-pc.sdk: x86_64 mainline ABIv1 SDK of nightly 2026-11-10
limitations: - AUTO uses CPU on this system: a program that has opened OpenGL leaves its
log file in use after it ends, and the Shell it ran in stops redirecting
the output of later programs (seen on nightly 2026-11-10). GPU opens
OpenGL all the same.
- OpenGL: with Mesa's software renderer AUTO uses CPU. GPU and hardware
OpenGL drivers have not been tested in this release.

aros-aarch64-abiv1-raspi.system: AROS on Raspberry Pi, AArch64 ABIv1 (nightly 2026-11-06 or later)
aros-aarch64-abiv1-raspi.sdk: Raspberry Pi AArch64 ABIv1 SDK of nightly 2026-11-10
limitations: - Tested in an emulator only, not on a physical Raspberry Pi, and from a
Shell with scripted edits; typing, the file requester and the clipboard
were tested on mainline x86_64 AROS only.
- OpenGL has not been tested on Pi hardware, so AUTO uses CPU. GPU has not
been tested in this release. Save your work before you try it.
- Changes of the whole window (scrolling, zooming, opening a dialog) redraw
all of it; on slow machines and in emulators these follow with a delay.
- No printing: export to PDF instead. Files dropped on the window are not
opened.
- All workbooks share one window; there is no separate window per workbook.
- Formatted (HTML) clipboard content is not available; copy and paste use
plain text and pictures.
- The control server (--control) and gridcraft-cli send, which drive a
running window, are not available.
- Saving a large workbook shows no progress in the window. The window
stays usable meanwhile; closing it waits until the file is written.
- No automatic updates: install new versions with the AROS package manager
or by unpacking the new archive.
- Pasting a picture from the clipboard, importing XLS, XLSB and ODS files,
charts and PDF export have not been tested on AROS in this release.
- Keyboard layouts other than the US one have not been tested. Chinese,
Japanese, Korean and emoji characters are kept in workbooks but may be
shown as boxes: no such font is built in or installed with AROS.
- The MCP server (gridcraft-cli mcp) has been tested only for its
handshake on AROS.
